name: Kappa Kiyup
body:
Up or down, it’s all the same to you.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics +4, Kappa, Kappa Crawl

Benefit: While prone you suffer no AC penalty vs. melee attacks. You may move from a prone position to a standing position as a free action which does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Normal: While prone, a character suffers a -4 AC penalty against melee attacks and moving from a prone position to a standing position is a move action which does provoke attacks of opportunity.
